description:
One Claude Code cloud routine per repo, fired by the site server with only the request id when a cloud request is approved. The routine's fixed prompt verifies the signed approval, claims the request, works on a branch, opens a PR, reports with cards commands and finishes with result.json and report.md. title: M3b PC runs
description:
Approved PC requests start on the gaming PC without a model making any check. A dispatch script verifies the site server's Ed25519 signature, the request hash, expiry and nonce against a key pinned at install, applies the caps, quiet hours and PC rules, claims with cards request take, prepares a guarded run folder and prints only id-bearing actions; a Haiku desktop task makes exactly those session calls. Runs use the limited pc-runner token, write run files through hub-hooks, wait for answers with cards ask wait, and end in a PR. Signed Unstick answers reach the run's own session, runs past 60 minutes are stopped, the PC stays awake during a run, the site server can wake it, and Bunnylink requests stay start-at-the-PC items. Done when, with the screen locked, a code task ends in a PR, a forged approval is refused and an answer reaches the run. Rollback: disable the dispatcher task.
